overview: A local services marketplace where providers list profiles and customers browse, review, and book them.
features: Browse a searchable, filterable directory of local service providers
View full provider profiles with category, rate, location, and photo
Leave star ratings and written reviews on providers
Request bookings with a date, time, and message
Providers accept or decline incoming booking requests
Admin management panel for providers, categories, and reviews
Seeded with example providers and reviews
